measures.title: Connect Bay Area Transit Initiative (Public Transit Revenue Measure District)
measures.summary: Would enact a sales tax of 0.5% in Alameda, Contra Costa, San Mateo and Santa Clara counties and 1% in San Francisco for 14 years, raising about $980 million a year. The money would go to BART, Caltrain, VTA, SamTrans, AC Transit, Muni and other transit, plus targeted road and pothole repair, with financial transparency and oversight requirements. It needs a majority vote.
measures.yesMeans: You want to enact the 0.5% regional transit sales tax in Santa Clara County for 14 years.
measures.noMeans: You do not want to enact the tax.
